title: Woodland Scout A-Z
hook: Spot each woodland clue with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: playful 3D woodland scout storybook, simple trail-map mood, green-gold palette, safe explorer tone, clear objects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a quiet woodland walker following tracks, leaves, birds and tree shapes
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: memorable two-line thematic reset with child-compatible echo
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses small woodland observations—bark, wings, tracks, leaves, shade and movement—with plenty of air.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses quiet cue-gap-answer phrasing, then one woodland motion such as hop, flap, sway, tap or trace.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
